title: 第691章 猴哥这是你的梦啊第690章 同样固执的母子
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
方师兄作为宗门当代第一天骄，他的突破自然吸引了无数人的注意，不只是宗门内，龙涛这两天在天枢阁里接到的报告，光是周边城镇出现可疑陌生面孔的记录就堆了一大摞。
这些能被发现的，估计都是一些小势力，甚至非仙门势力的探子，大部分人多半也没什么恶意，只是这种大事，习惯性的过来掺一脚而已，没什么大不了的。
那些真正麻烦的，这会儿估计已经潜入宗门内部，根本就没被发现呢。
至于结丹的安保和准备，那根本轮不到龙涛操心。别说方无歧这种年轻一代的门面人物，就算随便一个筑基弟子要结丹，对宗门也是头等大事。
保底会有一位元婴、两名金丹护法，阵法、丹药、法器、法宝，所有东西一整套流程走下来，师长亲友查一遍，宗门大能查一遍，还要请第三方无关人员再过一遍，防止一切可能的纰漏。
南宇辰这样的小年轻还有些不理解，但龙涛可是太理解了，身边最亲近的人，有时候也是不能完全相信的。
不信？要是在蓝星梦境，龙涛直接请他看一遍《赌神》，有几个人扛得住最后那一拨内外勾结的骗局呢，又不是所有人都是有十一万美元显隐眼镜的赌神，所以让无利益关联的第三方进行多一道检查，也是一种保险。
而方师兄似乎也没有任何的犹豫和纠结，在龙涛和袁姨那次见面的三天后，就准备突破了。
这个速度快到所有人都没想到，因为一般来说，结丹是需要较长时间的准备的，倒不是说物资，这些宗门早就准备好了，而是身心的准备，经脉和丹田的调理，神魂和精神状态的同调，正常来说，起码要个把月的。
毕竟这可是结丹，一辈子唯一的一次机会，哪怕多浪费一些时间，也要力求完美，但方无歧似乎完全没有这些打算，刚回来才几天啊，就立刻要行动起来了。
很快，这一天就来了。
而这天刚好也是殷哲进入梦境的日子。龙涛在主峰和他碰了一面，简单道了个别。
“行了，赶紧去你那位方师兄那边吧。”殷哲摆摆手，“我又不会死，就算真在梦境里出了岔子，也没什么好担心的。”
殷哲看着龙涛那焦急的样子，忍不住笑了出来。
“我知道，”龙涛嘴上这么应着，脚步却没急着挪，“可好歹得有点表示不是？要真头也不回地走了，怕你回头又要生气，你们这些孤寡老人，心里指不定就有什么别扭呢。”
“别把我想得跟爱吃醋的小姑娘似的。”殷哲笑了一声，语气却随即沉了半分，“倒是你！我听说你们家族那个诅咒了，筑基时都会招来雷劫。你准备得怎么样了？”
龙涛装作一副无所谓的样子道，
“哎呀，我是谁啊，都能跟着你从饿鬼道活着回来了，区区雷劫，小意思啦。”
殷哲看着他，难得收了笑意，声音放轻了些，
“总之，小心点吧。你这位师兄结丹的过程，你确实该好好看看，里面可能会有将来能救你一命的经验啊。”

龙涛点了点头，这其实也是他最关注的之一，但目前为止，他唯一亲眼见过的雷劫，好像就是明烛突破元婴的那次，而且因为各种原因，也没有近距离看到，只记得那仿佛要把人神魂都震碎的天雷了。
和殷哲正式告别后，龙涛骑着聆岚来到了方无歧的突破地点，一座由宗门特地打造的圆形盆地。
此刻这里算不上人山人海，因为大部分无关人士是不允许进来的，龙涛当然是相关人士，报了身份后就混进来了。
并且他很快就找到了南宇辰，还有和方无歧交好的一些师兄师姐，并且还看到了织影真人和小影。
“少爷！”
“小影！你也来啦？”
“嗯，师尊说这是难得的机会，一定要亲眼看看。”小影说着，眉头却微微皱着，
“不过我听说……方师兄这次想散尽全身功法，用向死而生的法子迎接天雷，我总觉得……不太妙。”
龙涛看着她那副担忧的样子，忽然想到自己筑基时也会被雷劈这件事，好像还没告诉她。算了，现在不说也好，不然这丫头怕是要当场拦着不让他突破了。
而这次织影真人带来的不只是小影，还有另一位亲传弟子。
content_en:
Senior Brother Fang is the sect's top genius today, and his breakthrough has naturally attracted the attention of countless people. Not only within the sect, the reports Long Tao has received in Tianshu Pavilion in the past two days include a pile of records of suspicious and unfamiliar faces in surrounding towns.
Those who can be discovered are probably spies from some small forces, or even non-immortal forces. Most people probably don't have any malicious intentions. They just come here to get involved in such big things out of habit. It's no big deal.
Those who are really troublesome have probably sneaked into the sect by now and have not been discovered at all.
As for the security and preparation of the pill formation, that was not Long Tao's turn to worry about. Not to mention a young figure like Fang Wuqi, even if a foundation-building disciple wanted to form a pill, it would be a top priority for the sect.
It is guaranteed that there will be one Nascent Soul, two golden elixir protectors, formations, elixirs, magic tools, and magic weapons. Everything will go through a complete process. The teacher, relatives and friends will check it, the sect will check it again, and a third-party unrelated person will be asked to go through it again to prevent any possible mistakes.
Young people like Nan Yuchen still don't understand, but Long Tao understands it too well. Sometimes the people closest to him cannot be completely believed.
Don’t believe it? If in Blue Star Dreamland, Long Tao directly asked him to watch "God of Gamblers", how many people would be able to withstand the last round of scams involving internal and external collusion? Not everyone is a God of Gamblers with $110,000 in contact lenses, so it is also a kind of insurance to allow an uninterested third party to conduct an additional inspection.
Senior Brother Fang didn't seem to have any hesitation or entanglement. Three days after the meeting between Long Tao and Aunt Yuan, he was ready to make a breakthrough.
This speed is so fast that no one expected it, because generally speaking, forming pills requires a long time of preparation. This does not mean that these sects have already prepared the materials, but the preparation of the body and mind, the regulation of the meridians and Dantian, and the synchronization of the soul and mental state. Normally, it takes at least a few months.
After all, this is pill formation, the only chance in a lifetime. Even if it wastes more time, we must strive for perfection. However, Fang Wuqi seems to have no such plans at all. He has only been back for a few days, and he has to take action immediately.
Soon, this day came.
And this day happened to be the day when Yin Zhe entered the dreamland. Long Tao met him on the main peak and said goodbye briefly.
"Okay, hurry up and go to your senior brother Fang." Yin Zhe waved his hand, "I won't die. Even if something goes wrong in the dream, there is nothing to worry about."
Yin Zhe looked at Long Tao's anxious look and couldn't help but laugh.
"I know," Long Tao said in response, but did not move in a hurry, "But at least you have to show it a little bit, right? If you really leave without looking back, I'm afraid you will be angry again when you look back, you lonely old people may have something wrong with you."
"Don't think of me like a jealous little girl." Yin Zhe laughed, but his tone immediately dropped, "It's you! I heard that your family has a curse, and when you build a foundation, it will cause thunder disaster. How are you prepared?"
Long Tao pretended to be indifferent and said,
"Oh, who am I? I can follow you and come back alive from the Hungry Ghost Realm. It's just a thunder disaster. It's not a big deal."
Yin Zhe looked at him, rarely smiled, and his voice became softer.
"Anyway, be careful. You really should take a close look at your senior brother's process of forming an elixir. There may be experience in it that can save your life in the future."
Long Tao nodded. This was actually one of the things he was most concerned about. But so far, the only thunder tribulation he had seen with his own eyes seemed to be the time when Mingzhu broke through the Nascent Soul. And for various reasons, he had not seen it up close. He only remembered the thunder that seemed to shatter the soul of a person.
After formally bidding farewell to Yin Zhe, Long Tao rode Ling Lan to Fang Wuqi's breakthrough point, a specially built by the sect.Circular basin.
It's not a crowded place at this moment, because most unrelated people are not allowed to come in. Of course, Long Tao is a related person, and he sneaked in after reporting his identity.
And he quickly found Nan Yuchen and some senior brothers and sisters who were good friends with Fang Wuqi, and also saw Zhiying Zhenren and Xiaoying.
"Master!"
"Xiaoying! Are you here too?"
"Well, Master said this is a rare opportunity. You must see it with your own eyes." Xiaoying said, but frowned slightly.
"But I heard...Senior Brother Fang wants to use all his energy this time to face the thunder of death, and I always feel...not good."
Long Tao looked at her worried look, and suddenly thought of the fact that he would be struck by lightning when building a foundation, and it seemed that he hadn't told her yet. Forget it, it's better not to say it now, otherwise this girl might stop him on the spot to prevent him from breaking through.
And this time Master Zhiying brought not only Xiaoying, but also another direct disciple.
